about: Every clock change from 2026-10-16 to the end of 2100 in these zones, and what a wall time near each change becomes (spec 6.2, ALARM-6): a time that does not exist moves forward by the length of the gap ('gap'), a time that happens twice takes the first instant ('overlap'). Made by tools/vectors/build-vectors.py from the tz database with Python's zoneinfo; core/zoned.js wallTimeToInstant must give the same instant and the same word for every row, and so must stage B's java.time port (ZonedDateTime.of then withEarlierOffsetAtOverlap). Each row: [local date, wall time, instant UTC, none | gap | overlap]. Africa/Casablanca is left out: tz releases disagree about Morocco's future changes. A device whose tz database is older or newer than the one recorded here may differ where a zone's rules changed.
